ocr.notes: Closely matches; 'Ask 'im when 'e gets home' is ''ome' in the image, 'per cent' printed as two words.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen returned to St. Louis from Jacksonville after backing the loser, Charley Mitchell, against Corbett, and was too busy hunting a lost diamond ring to be interviewed.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Saturday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Jan[uary 27, 18]94 (partly torn; Saturday matches Jan. 27, 1894).

facts.fact: Allen returned to St. Louis from Jacksonville by the L. & N. railroad after the Corbett-Mitchell fight, the only one of the St. Louis sports to make the trip
Allen had picked Mitchell to beat Corbett and had prepared his ox tail jelly 'stomach hardener' for Mitchell
Asked how he liked the Corbett-Mitchell fight, Allen answered that there was no fight
facts.quote: Foight! Foight! There was no fight
